_about: Disclosed AI revenue run-rates ($B annualized): reported figures from press releases and earnings, the dollar check on the token-volume estimate. Read by AI Economy (the chain summary) and the AI revenue check on AI Economy → Tensions. approx: true marks a figure read from press coverage rather than the company. Rows whose src starts "S-1" are audited or reviewed quarterly revenue from Anthropic's registration statement (EDGAR, filed 2026-10-26), annualized as quarter revenue × 4 and dated to the quarter's middle month: a quarter average, so for a company growing this fast it sits below the run-rate at quarter end. Anthropic's own Run-Rate Revenue is trailing-28-day usage fees × 13 plus current monthly subscriptions × 12; the S-1 leaves its figure blank until an amendment. Add a row per new disclosure.

disclosures.src: told investors ~$50B annualized at end of September (CNBC, Oct 8, 2026)
